desc: Implement and validate the offline sweep with a max Fenwick tree, including strict-smaller DP transitions and queries sorted by prefix endpoint R.
Derive the LIS-ending DP recurrence and identify that equal values must not be predecessors.
Work out coordinate compression and conversion of arbitrary query X to the largest array-value coordinate not exceeding X.
Establish that a query is the maximum LIS-ending DP over prefix positions with values at most X.
